INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TAKE_A_BREAK.title: Take a Break
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TAKE_A_BREAK.banter: [sine]*Yawn*...[/sine] I seem to be getting a bit drowsy... Would you mind if we continued this later?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TAKE_A_BREAK.descripti:
Heal [green]{Heal:diff()}[/green] HP.
Gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
End your turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IGNITE.title: Ignite
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DUAL_PURPOSE_GUN.title: 4.5-Inch Dual-Purpose Gun
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DUAL_PURPOSE_GUN.descr:
[gold]Versatile[/gold]: If played automatically, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Otherwise, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the end of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]hand[/gold] and hasn't been played this turn, automatically play it.{InCombat:{WillAutoBlock:cond:>0?[green](Will automatically play for anti-air defense)[/green]|[red](Already played this turn)[/red]}|}
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ZIGZAG_MANEUVER.title: Zigzag Maneuver
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.title: Work Arrangement
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.bante: Huh, work? I've already finished all of it.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.descr:
Cost [blue]{MotivationConsume:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.selec: Choose a card to put on the bottom of your Draw Pile.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ILLUSTRIOUS_AEGIS.desc:
Grant any player {Shield:diff()} [gold]Shield[/gold].
Heals [green]{Heal:diff()}[/green] HP when this [gold]Shield[/gold] breaks.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-VICTORIOUS_SONG.title: Victorious Song
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-VICTORIOUS_SONG.descri:
Deal [blue]{VictoriousSongPower:diff()}[/blue] additional attack damage to the enemy with the highest current HP.
Take [blue]{DamageReduction:diff()}[/blue] less attack damage from that enemy.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FORMIDABLE_PRESSURE.de:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each time a debuff was applied to this enemy this turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SORORAL_UNITY.title: Sororal Unity
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SORORAL_UNITY.descript: Add an Illustrious Aegis, a Victorious Song, and a Formidable Pressure to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWORDFISH_BOMBER.title: Swordfish
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply [blue]{FloodingPower:diff()}[/blue] [blue]Flooded[/blue].
If the enemy intends to attack or escape, apply [gold]Slow[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-BARRACUDA_MK2.title: Barracuda Mk.II
Deal double damage ({Damage:diff()}) to targets with [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply [gold]Armor Break[/gold] equal to the un-doubled damage.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_F46.title: Seafire F.46
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_F46.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy intends to attack, apply [blue]{InterceptedPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Intercepted[/gold], otherwise gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_FR47.title: Seafire FR.47
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TACTICAL_TRAINING.desc: Choose a [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Gain [blue]{SpecialPowerAmount:diff()}[/blue] corresponding Aviation power (or generic [gold]Aviation[/gold] if without sub-type).
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TACTICAL_TRAINING.sele: Choose a Carrier Aircraft card for Tactical Training.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.title: Art of Resting
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.banter: All forms of relaxation serve a purpose, and are DEFINITELY not slacking off.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.descrip:
[gold]Transform[/gold] all [gold]Indolent[/gold] cards in your piles into [gold]Refresh[/gold].
Whenever you create a Status card, [gold]Transform[/gold] it into a [gold]Refresh[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-MOTIVATION_BURST.title: Motivation Burst
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EMERGENCY_TAKEOFF.desc:
Put a random [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] or Attack card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] (Aircraft takes priority).
It's free to play this turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CASUAL_STRIKE.title: Casual Strike
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CASUAL_STRIKE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold]. If you have less than [blue]{Threshold:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold], gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold] again.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RETROFIT_STRIKE.title: Retrofit Strike
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RETROFIT_STRIKE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose a non-[gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and add [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RETROFIT_STRIKE.select: Choose a non-Carrier Aircraft card to retrofit.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNEXPECTED_MAIL.title: Unexpected Mail
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNEXPECTED_MAIL.banter: New mail? Are we being told to go on vacation? Huh, what do you mean that's not possible?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNEXPECTED_MAIL.descri:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add a random {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] }[gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-AIR_SUPERIORITY.title: Air Superiority
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-AIR_SUPERIORITY.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deals 1 additional time for each [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] played this combat beyond current enemy count.{InCombat:(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CLEANUP.title: Cleanup
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CLEANUP.banter: I'm sure someone with THIS many maids would live an absolutely blessed lifestyle...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CLEANUP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. If it is a Status or Curse, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DECK_TIE_DOWN.title: Deck Tie-down
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DECK_TIE_DOWN.selectio: Choose {Cards:plural:a card|up to {} cards} to Retain.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HANGAR_REPAIR.title: Hangar Repair
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HANGAR_REPAIR.descript: Choose a damaged [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and restore [blue]ALL[/blue] of its Durability.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HANGAR_REPAIR.selectio: Select a Carrier Aircraft to repair.
At the start of your turn, restore a total of {ScheduledMaintenancePower:diff()} Durability to random [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FIREPOWER_SUPPLY.title: Firepower Supply
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FIREPOWER_SUPPLY.descr: [gold]Versatile[/gold]: Choose to add an{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} [gold]Incendiary Expert[/gold] or [gold]Enhanced AP Ammo[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ARMOURED_CARRIER.title: Armoured Carrier
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ARMOURED_CARRIER.bante: I am the fourth ship of the Illustrious class, armored carrier Indomitable.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ARMOURED_CARRIER.descr:
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{ShieldPower}[/blue] [gold]Shield[/gold], and
[gold]Elegance[/gold]: Gain [blue]{AviationPower}[/blue] [gold]Aviation[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PAJAMA_REVOLUTION.bant: Want to take a nap with me? Yeah, I meant right here.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PAJAMA_REVOLUTION.desc:
Apply [blue]{EnemyHypnotized:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Hypnotized[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Apply [blue]{AllyHypnotized:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Hypnotized[/gold] to ALL allies.
ALL players gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-NIGHT_RAID.title: Night Raid
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-NIGHT_RAID.description:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Choose an Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and play it. It deals {DamageMultiplier:diff()}x damage to [gold]Sleeping[/gold] enemies.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TEA_PARTY_IN_THE_WOODS:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Cost [blue]{MotivationConsume:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Dessert|Desserts}[/gold] into ALL players' [gold]Draw Piles[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EVASIVE_MANEUVERS.desc:
This turn, your next {EvasiveManeuversPower:diff()} [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] cards take 0 [gold]Durability[/gold] loss.
[gold]Exhausts[/gold] after {Durability} plays.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ONE_PERSON_SCHOOL.desc:
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and transform it into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Insight+|Insight}[/gold] with the same [gold]Enchantment[/gold].
For each time the selected card has been [gold]Upgraded[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] the created [gold]Insight[/gold] once more.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ONE_PERSON_SCHOOL.sele: Choose a card in your Hand to transform into Insight, preserving its Enchantment.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-MASTER_OF_LIFE.title: Master of Life
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-MASTER_OF_LIFE.descrip:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Whenever you heal HP during combat, gain {MasterOfLifePower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-KENOSIS_FORM.title: Kenosis Form
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-KENOSIS_FORM.descripti: At the start of your turn, heal {KenosisFormPower:diff()} HP. Whenever you heal HP, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold] and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Refresh+[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SELFIE.title: Selfie
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SELFIE.description: Every [blue]4[/blue] non-[gold]Status[/gold], non-[gold]Curse[/gold] cards you create, the next {SelfiePower:diff()} {SelfiePower:plural:card you play gains|cards you play gain} [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SECOND_HANGAR.title: Second Hangar
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SECOND_HANGAR.banter: Of course I'd be somewhat different from my sisters... Hey, I'm talking about hangar capacity here, not service history or repair length.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SECOND_HANGAR.descript:
Lose {BlockLoss:inverseDiff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Increase your maximum hand size by {SecondHangarPower:diff()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INNER_ARMOR.title: Inner Armor
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INNER_ARMOR.descriptio: The next time you are attacked and your [gold]Block[/gold] or [gold]Shield[/gold] breaks, gain [gold]Shield[/gold] equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-YOGA.title: Yoga
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-YOGA.description:
Whenever you gain, require, or consume [gold]Motivation[/gold] this turn, gain {YogaPower:diff()} [gold]Shield[/gold].
Gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEA_GLADIATOR.title: Sea Gladiator
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEA_GLADIATOR.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you are attacked, if this card is not in your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], increase its damage and [gold]Block[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue] and return it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEA_HURRICANE.title: Sea Hurricane
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEA_HURRICANE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you are attacked, increase its damage by 2 this combat.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SKUA.title: Skua
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SKUA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.{WeakPower:cond:>0? Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].|}
Every turn this card is [gold]Retained[/gold], its damage increases by {Increase:diff()} and it applies [blue]1[/blue] additional [gold]Weak[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RADAR_DETECTION.title: Radar Detection
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-AIRSPACE_RECON.title: Airspace Recon
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-AIRSPACE_RECON.descrip:
[gold]Recon[/gold] [blue]{Recon:cond:>0?3X+{Recon:diff()}|3X}[/blue].
The [blue]{IfUpgraded:show:first X (at least 1)|first}[/blue] card put into your [gold]Hand[/gold] this way is free to play this turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RETIRE.title: Retire
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RETIRE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
If it is a [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:ALL cards|a card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold]; otherwise, gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RALLY.title: Rally
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RALLY.description:
Cost [blue]{MotivationConsume:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Shuffle your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. For every [blue]{Threshold:diff()}[/blue] cards shuffled this way, put a [gold]Refresh[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LOGISTICS_EXCHANGE.des: Choose 2 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Swap their current energy costs and use as basic costs this combat.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LOGISTICS_EXCHANGE.sel: Choose 2 cards to swap their energy costs.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWEET_DEAL.title: Sweet Deal
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWEET_DEAL.banter: Double my vacation time, buy me some sweets, and I'll keep this a secret. Hehe, not such a bad deal, right?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWEET_DEAL.description: You and another player each choose a card in [gold]Hand[/gold] to become free this turn. The chosen cards are given to each other when played, and return back when played again.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWEET_DEAL.selectionSc: Choose a card to lend to your ally.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ENGAGE_ON_SIGHT.title: Engage on Sight
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ENGAGE_ON_SIGHT.banter: I'm going to tell my sisters, you know?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ENGAGE_ON_SIGHT.descri: Whenever you draw an Attack {IfUpgraded:show:| during your turn}, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WITHERER.title: Witherer
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WITHERER.description: After dealing a total of {Threshold} [gold]On Fire[/gold] or [gold]Flooding[/gold] damage this combat, the first {WithererPower:plural:[gold]Debuff[/gold] you apply to an enemy each turn is|{WithererPower:diff()} [gold]Debuffs[/gold] you apply to enemies each turn are} applied an extra time.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ICED_DRINK.title: Iced Drink
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ICED_DRINK.banter: Here, your ice-cold drink. I only drank a little of it.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ICED_DRINK.description:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Remove all [gold]On Fire[/gold] from the enemy and apply an equal amount of [gold]Flooding[/gold]. If at least 5 are removed, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-BURNING_PASSION.title: Burning Passion
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-BURNING_PASSION.banter: All this jumping about is making it hard to rela – I mean, to hold back...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-BURNING_PASSION.descri:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Remove all [gold]Flooding[/gold] from the enemy and apply an equal amount of [gold]On Fire[/gold]. If at least 1 is removed, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FURIOUS.title: Furious
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FURIOUS.banter: *sigh*... I knew I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FURIOUS.description:
Whenever you apply 4 or more [gold]On Fire[/gold], draw [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Apply {OnFirePower:diff()} [gold]On Fire[/gold] to yourself.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DEMOLITION_EXPERT.desc: Whenever you apply [gold]On Fire[/gold] or [gold]Flooding[/gold] to enemies, apply an additional [blue]{DemolitionExpertPower:diff()}[/blue].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SAFE_AND_SOUND.title: Safe and Sound
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LADYS_WHIM.title: Lady's Whim
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LADYS_WHIM.banter: Her taste in music is a bit... too noisy for my tastes.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LADYS_WHIM.description: Whenever you play a kind of card you haven't played this turn, gain [blue]{LadysWhimPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]{LadysWhimPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNFULFILLED_VOW.title: Unfulfilled Vow
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNFULFILLED_VOW.banter: I swear to stand with you this time!
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-UNFULFILLED_VOW.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the end of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], put a [gold]Resolve[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SLACK_OFF.title: Slack Off
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SLACK_OFF.description:
Cost [blue]{MotivationConsume:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Put {Cards:diff()} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Refresh+|Refresh}[/gold] cards on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SALVAGE.title: Salvage
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SALVAGE.description: Choose up to {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and put {Cards:plural:it|them} into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Remove [gold]Ethereal[/gold] from {Cards:plural:it|them} and fully restore {Cards:plural:its|their} [gold]Durability[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SALVAGE.selectionScree: Choose up to {Amount} {Amount:plural:card|cards} to put into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HAPPY_BIRTHDAY.title: Happy Birthday
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HAPPY_BIRTHDAY.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply [blue]{OnFirePower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]On Fire[/gold].
Repeat until the enemy has at least [blue]{OnFireThreshold:diff()}[/blue] [gold]On Fire[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EXTRACT_THE_FIREWOOD.d:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
For each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply [blue]{OnFirePower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]On Fire[/gold] to a random enemy.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EXTRACT_THE_FIREWOOD.s: Choose up to {Amount} cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ONSEN_JOURNEY.title: Onsen Journey
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ONSEN_JOURNEY.descript:
Put up to {Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
For each card that enters your [gold]Hand[/gold], apply [blue]{FloodingPower:diff()}[/blue] [blue]Flooded[/blue] to a random enemy.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ONSEN_JOURNEY.selectio: Choose up to {Amount} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOMITABLE_PRAYER.des:
Gain {Shield:diff()} [gold]Shield[/gold].
This turn, whenever you take damage, it is capped at the previous damage you took.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DESSERT.title: Dessert
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-REFRESH.title: Refresh
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INCENDIARY_EXPERT.desc: Choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [purple]High-Explosive[/purple] [blue]{HighExplosiveAmount:diff()}[/blue].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ENHANCED_AP_AMMO.title: Enhanced AP Ammo
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ENHANCED_AP_AMMO.descr: Choose [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [purple]Armor-Piercing[/purple].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INSIGHT.title: Insight
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INSIGHT.description:
Choose up to [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them and inherit this card's [gold]Enchantment[/gold].
Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] repeatedly. Each upgrade lets you choose 1 more card.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INSIGHT.selectionScree: Choose up to {Amount} cards to Upgrade and/or Enchant.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOLENT.title: Indolent
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOLENT.description:
Whenever you draw this card, lose {MotivationConsume} [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Discard a card.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WELL_RESTED.title: Well-Rested
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WELL_RESTED.descriptio: Whenever you draw this card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RESOLVE.title: Resolve
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RESOLVE.description:
Gain [blue]{MotivationGain:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Reduce the cost of all your [gold]Unfulfilled Vow[/gold] cards by [blue]1[/blue], and apply [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to all your [gold]Resolve[/gold] cards.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SCORCHING_FLAME_RAIN.d:
[gold]Requires[/gold] [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply [blue]{OnFirePower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]On Fire[/gold] to ALL enemies.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FULL_CONCENTRATION.des: Whenever you have [blue]100[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold], you may click the [gold]Earnest Mode[/gold] button to gain [blue]{FullConcentrationPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Earnest Mode[/gold] and take an extra turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DISPATCH_COMMISSION.ba: New missions, huh... Should be no problem at all for someone as experienced as you, right?
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DISPATCH_COMMISSION.de: Another player adds 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} [gold]Commission[/gold] card to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-COMMISSION_CARD_COMPLE: That's another mission taken care of! Hehe, you're pretty good at this, Commander.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-OIL_COMMISSION.title: Oilfield Dev.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-OIL_COMMISSION.descrip:
[gold]Commission[/gold]: gaining {MaxProgress:energyIcons()}{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EXERCISE_COMMISSION.de:
[gold]Commission[/gold]: dealing {MaxProgress} damage to enemies{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TRANSPORT_COMMISSION.d:
[gold]Commission[/gold]: drawing {MaxProgress} cards{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ESCORT_COMMISSION.desc:
[gold]Commission[/gold]: gaining {MaxProgress} [gold]Block[/gold]{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
After combat, you and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].

INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LAUNCH_CEREMONY.descri:
